title: NOT AS ADVERTISED
text: NOT AS ADVERTISED. I was not sent the proper scale. The scale sent to me does not weigh up to 0.001 as advertised. I feel like I was sent an entirely incorrect scale, this one is grey where the one advertised I’d black!!

product_metadata.title: WAOAW W-01-50 Digital Milligram Scale 50 X 0.001Gram Reloading Jewelry Scale Digital Weight with Calibration Weights Tweezers and Weighing Pans (Batteries Included)
features: Accurate Digital Milligram Scale - Weighs up to 50 grams in 0.001 gram / 0.1gn increments.
Back Light Display- LCD screen Will display readings in G, OZ, OZT, DWT, CT and GN.
Tare Range - Precision Tare Button calculates the net weight of your ingredients (automatically subtracts the weight of any bowl or container).

Multi Functions and Widely Used - This Digital scale can be used as a Jewelry scale, Lab scale, diamond scale and Carat Scale. The PCS function gives you an accurate count and the hold function will lock weight readings.
Includings - 2 x AAA batteries, 1 x Tweezers, 1 x Calibration Weight, 1 x Weighing Pan; when you receive scale, please calibrate it before using.
